text.arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم ۖ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ ۖ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ

words.gloss_range: perfect plural speech verb introducing a complete quoted answer
words.root_gloss_range: q-w-l ranges over saying, declaration, opinion, and claim; here direct-speech grammar selects accountable testimony
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) makes the ayah a reported answer, not neutral narration. The perfect plural form assigns the testimony to the questioned speakers from 34:40 and governs the full quotation that follows. The q-w-l range gives that answer public claim-weight: loyalty and worship are now exposed in speech before the correction redirects the suspected object.

topics.headline: reported answer as accountable testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reply is assigned to the questioned plural speakers and frames the whole ayah as their completed testimony.
topics.reason: The perfect plural speech verb introduces the entire quotation as the answer of the beings addressed in 34:40.

topics.headline: speech as public claim, not private perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the relation under dispute is processed through an exposed, testable utterance.
topics.reason: The q-w-l range supports articulate saying and claim-making, and the local quotation performs exonerating testimony.

topics.headline: question becomes testimony across the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same speech field turns from divine interrogation in 34:40 into the speakers' answer in 34:41.
topics.reason: The boundary keeps the speech-root frame while changing speaker and aspect; the cadence row supports the measured opening rather than adding a separate lexical claim.

words.gloss_range: formulaic accusative exoneration with direct second-person suffix
words.root_gloss_range: s-b-ḥ ranges from moving freely or away to glorifying; here the formula selects tanzih, divine removal from false attribution
words.prose: {{ar:سُبْحَٰنَكَ}} ({{tr:subḥānaka}}) is a compact act of exoneration. The verbal-noun form lets the speakers clear God before they defend themselves, and the suffix makes the praise directly addressed rather than abstract. The s-b-ḥ motion-away field survives as a positive image of clearing false relation away, while local formula and address narrow it to tanzih; the same answer-register is recognizable in exonerating scenes such as 25:18 and 5:116.

topics.headline: compressed exonerating formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer begins by performing divine exoneration before explaining the disputed relation.
topics.reason: The accusative verbal noun with an implied verb functions as a complete exclamatory utterance inside the quote.

topics.headline: suffix anchors direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the formula is not abstract praise; it is directed to the divine addressee before the patronage claim.
topics.reason: The attached second-person suffix fixes the addressee, and the word stands first in the quoted reply.

topics.headline: motion-away image narrowed to transcendence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a clearing-away force in the formula, while the local construction narrows the root range to theological exoneration.
topics.reason: The root family includes motion and free movement, but the formulaic maṣdar with divine suffix selects tanzih and removal from false attribution.

topics.headline: exonerating answer pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening belongs to a recognizable answer pattern where accused beings clear God before any self-defense.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows name exonerating answer scenes such as 25:18 and 5:116; the local opening matches that register.

words.gloss_range: independent second-person pronoun as explicit subject of the patronage clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: singular predicate noun with first-person plural suffix: our patron/protector in a stable nominal relation
formulaic accusative exoneration with direct second-person suffix

words.prose: {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}) is not a throwaway pronoun. Arabic could leave the subject implicit, but the independent form focuses the divine addressee before {{ar:وَلِيُّنَا}} ({{tr:waliyyunā}}). It also escalates the address from the suffix in {{ar:سُبْحَٰنَكَ}} ({{tr:subḥānaka}}) to a full subject, setting up a contrastive patronage frame before the excluded plural appears.

topics.headline: overt focused subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine addressee is made explicit as the subject instead of being left implicit in the nominal clause.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is locally the subject of the patronage predicate and supplies focus that an omitted subject would not carry.

topics.headline: suffix address becomes independent pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the address intensify from attached suffix to full pronoun before the exclusive patronage claim.
topics.reason: The same divine addressee appears first as a suffix and then as an independent pronoun.

topics.headline: contrastive patronage frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun helps reroute the accused relation toward God as patron and away from the plural group being excluded.
topics.reason: The overt subject precedes the predicate and the exclusion phrase, creating contrast before the corrective pivot.

words.gloss_range: singular predicate noun with first-person plural suffix: our patron/protector in a stable nominal relation
words.root_gloss_range: w-l-y spans nearness, alliance, protection, jurisdiction, and turning-toward; here patronage is protective governing nearness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: corrective discourse particle replacing the prior frame with the actual worship account

words.prose: {{ar:وَلِيُّنَا}} ({{tr:waliyyunā}}) fuses the patron noun to the speakers' plural suffix, so the claim is their specific standing relation to one patron. The noun form does not narrate a new act of allegiance; it states a stable status. The w-l-y field makes that status protective nearness and authority, which will be set against misplaced confidence at the close, with 2:257 as a strong patronage parallel. As the predicate of the nominal denial, it helps complete the patronage claim before {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) opens a replacement account.

topics.headline: specific standing patronage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers claim one stable patron relation for themselves, not a newly performed act of allegiance.
topics.reason: The noun predicate is definite through the first-person plural suffix, singular in patron reference, and predicative in the nominal clause.

topics.headline: protective nearness and authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patronage means protective governing nearness, not mere friendship.
topics.reason: The w-l-y range includes nearness, alliance, protection, and orientation, while the exclusion phrase selects protective authority.

topics.headline: true patronage contrasted with misplaced trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine patronage and final misplaced belief are relation-words set against each other, especially with 2:257 in view.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect patronage language with belief language; locally the speakers claim God as patron while the final clause diagnoses trust in the wrong object.

topics.headline: complete denial before correction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the patronage clause is complete before the correction begins, so the next clause is a replacement account.
topics.reason: The nominal clause is syntactically complete before the corrective particle, making the first-person loyalty claim the core denial.

words.gloss_range: preposition of separation/exclusion governing the following boundary noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governed boundary noun with plural suffix: apart from/besides them in the patronage denial
corrective discourse particle replacing the prior frame with the actual worship account

words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) is the visible exclusion operator in the patronage phrase. With {{ar:دُونِهِم}} ({{tr:dūnihim}}), it makes the claim relational: God is patron apart from the excluded plural group, not merely patron in a general sense. The small particle is tightly bound to its governed exclusion phrase rather than floating independently. Its position closes the denial before {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) opens the corrective account.

topics.headline: separation as exclusion in patronage phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle actively marks patronage away from a rival plural referent, not simple origin.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following noun in a min dun phrase that qualifies the patronage predicate by separation and exclusion.

topics.headline: prepositional close before correction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exclusion phrase finishes the denial before the ayah turns to the real object of worship.
topics.reason: The phrase stands immediately before the corrective particle and completes the nominal patronage clause.

topics.headline: compact binding to governed phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the small particle is tightly bound to the governed exclusion phrase rather than floating independently.
topics.reason: The sound observation supports the same grammatical attachment already required by the prepositional construction.

words.gloss_range: governed boundary noun with plural suffix: apart from/besides them in the patronage denial
words.root_gloss_range: d-w-n ranges around below, short of, apart from, and besides; here min-governance selects exclusion with rank-lowering pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite collective accusative: the jinn as explicit object of worship

words.prose: {{ar:دُونِهِم}} ({{tr:dūnihim}}) makes the excluded plural a grammatical boundary. The suffix keeps the accused group from 34:40 in view while the preposition frames them as outside true patronage. The d-w-n field gives the exclusion a below/besides pressure, but the local phrase does not activate a d-y-n debt or religion derivation. Structurally the word comes before {{ar:ٱلْجِنَّ}} ({{tr:al-jinna}}), so the ayah first removes a false relation and only then identifies the hidden object.

topics.headline: governed excluded boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural group from the accusation remains grammatically present as the boundary excluded from patronage.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the preceding preposition and carries a definite plural suffix tied to the prior discourse group.

topics.headline: besides/apart with rank-lowering pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the excluded relation is both other than and beneath true patronage, while local grammar selects the min dun exclusion sense.
topics.reason: The root range supports below, short of, besides, and apart; the local governed phrase selects relational exclusion while preserving rank pressure.

topics.headline: d-y-n alternative does not govern this surface
topics.blocking_evidence: The aligned QAC root is d-w-n and the attachment evidence makes the word the governed object of the exclusion phrase, not a d-y-n religious/debt form.
topics.reason: The aligned root and governed min dun construction support d-w-n lowness/exclusion, not d-y-n debt or religion.

topics.headline: exclusion before identification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a staged relation map: first the false patronage relation is excluded, then the hidden worship object is named.
topics.reason: The word precedes the named jinn object and its suffix later echoes in the final belief complement.

words.gloss_range: corrective discourse particle replacing the prior frame with the actual worship account

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite collective accusative: the jinn as explicit object of worship

words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) is the ayah's hinge. After the complete patronage denial, it cancels the suspected relation and opens the corrective backstory. Before it, the speakers define loyalty upward to God; after it, the text diagnoses human service toward {{ar:ٱلْجِنَّ}} ({{tr:al-jinna}}), so 34:40 is reread through a new object.

topics.headline: corrective replacement after denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle replaces the suspected angel-worship frame with a stronger account of actual practice.
topics.reason: The particle follows a complete denial and precedes the past habitual worship clause, giving it corrective iḍrāb force.

topics.headline: hinge between patronage and worship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verse split into two relation frames: loyalty to God before the particle, service to jinn after it.
topics.reason: The particle prevents the following worship clause from being read as mere continuation of the patronage predicate.

topics.headline: prior question reread through new object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 34:40 remains open until this pivot starts the replacement object account.
topics.reason: The particle depends on the prior question and prepares the shift from suspected angel-object to jinn-object.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural auxiliary governing the following imperfect as prior habitual practice
words.root_gloss_range: k-w-n ranges over being, occurrence, and formation; here the simple auxiliary selects state-history rather than formation or creation command

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperfect plural worship verb under past auxiliary, transitive to the named jinn object
definite collective accusative: the jinn as explicit object of worship

words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) turns the correction into history. Its plural subject routes back to the accused worshippers, and as an auxiliary before {{ar:يَعْبُدُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿbudūna}}) it makes the worship a prior habitual condition, not a single lapse. The same auxiliary-worship frame crosses from the 34:40 accusation into the answer, while the object changes to {{ar:ٱلْجِنَّ}} ({{tr:al-jinna}}). The k-w-n state field is active, while formation or creation-command branches such as 2:117 remain contrastive rather than local.

topics.headline: past habitual auxiliary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the correction reaches a settled prior pattern, not an isolated worship act.
topics.reason: The perfect auxiliary governs the imperfect worship verb and creates a prior habitual or continuative frame.

topics.headline: plural subject routes to worshippers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the corrective clause diagnoses the worshippers from 34:40, not the angels who are speaking.
topics.reason: The plural agreement on the auxiliary resumes the accused worshipper group in the corrective clause.

topics.headline: state-history, not formation branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that k-w-n contributes state-history here while causative formation or creation-command branches remain outside the local sense.
topics.reason: The local form is the simple auxiliary state verb, not a causative or creation-command construction; 2:117 is contrastive only.

topics.headline: pivot opens counter-history
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same auxiliary-worship frame crosses from accusation into answer while the object changes.
topics.reason: The sequence after the corrective particle opens a prior-state account, and the repeated worship frame makes object replacement visible.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural worship verb under past auxiliary, transitive to the named jinn object
words.root_gloss_range: ʿ-b-d ranges over worship, service, submission, and servitude; here repeated directed worship/service is active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: corrective discourse particle replacing the prior frame with the actual worship account
definite collective accusative: the jinn as explicit object of worship
perfect plural auxiliary governing the following imperfect as prior habitual practice

words.prose: {{ar:يَعْبُدُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿbudūna}}) carries the corrective payload after {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}). The verb keeps the worshippers as subject and takes {{ar:ٱلْجِنَّ}} ({{tr:al-jinna}}) as its object, so the question of worship is resolved by direction. Under {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}), the imperfect profiles repeated service and practical submission; the force is sharpened by 1:5, where worship is restricted to God, while here the same worship field is displaced to concealed beings.

topics.headline: transitive worship toward named object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that worship is grammatically directed toward a named object, so agency and object are sorted in the corrective clause.
topics.reason: The imperfect plural verb shares the auxiliary subject and takes the following definite noun as direct object.

topics.headline: worship as repeated servitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the error includes practical service, obedience, and dependence, not only a stray belief.
topics.reason: The ʿ-b-d range supports worship, service, and subjection; the habitual frame makes repeated submission visible.

topics.headline: imperfect stretches action into pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action remains open and repeated under the auxiliary instead of being closed as one completed act.
topics.reason: The imperfect is governed by the perfect auxiliary, producing durative or habitual aspect.

topics.headline: exclusive worship formula inverted by object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same worship field that can express exclusive devotion to God is here exposed through a displaced object.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the verb to 1:5 and to the 34:40 question; the local object replacement is the point of the correction.

words.gloss_range: definite collective accusative: the jinn as explicit object of worship
words.root_gloss_range: j-n-n spans concealment, covered places/things, and jinn; here worship-object grammar selects concealed rational agents

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: corrective discourse particle replacing the prior frame with the actual worship account
bound plural pronoun governed by the preceding preposition, with strong local pressure toward the jinn antecedent but some discourse openness
imperfect plural worship verb under past auxiliary, transitive to the named jinn object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجِنَّ}} ({{tr:al-jinna}}) supplies the replacement object that {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) prepares. Its definiteness names an identifiable class, and its accusative role makes concealed beings the explicit answer to the worship question. The j-n-n concealment field is narrowed to hidden rational agency because they receive worship and are later resumed by {{ar:هِم}} ({{tr:him}}); 6:100 gives the hidden-partner backdrop. The noun also bridges the outward service of {{ar:يَعْبُدُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿbudūna}}) to the inward trust named at the close.

topics.headline: definite accusative worship object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the correction names an identifiable concealed class as the object of worship, not a vague or incidental detail.
topics.reason: The definite collective noun is accusative as the direct object of the worship verb.

topics.headline: concealment narrowed to hidden agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's concealment field becomes hidden rational agency here, while garden, shield, or covering-action branches are not local senses.
topics.reason: The word is a concrete noun receiving worship and later plural-pronoun uptake, so concealed beings are selected from the broader j-n-n family.

topics.headline: hidden partner-class contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 6:100 sharpens the correction by associating jinn with improper partnership.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row supplies 6:100 as a concrete recurrence, and the local ayah redirects worship to that hidden class.

topics.headline: object bridges practice and belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the named object remains active into the final pronoun, linking outward worship to inward confidence.
topics.reason: The noun stands between the habitual worship clause and the final belief clause, then is resumed by the belief complement pronoun.

words.gloss_range: elative construct meaning most of them, as subject of the final nominal clause
words.root_gloss_range: k-th-r ranges around abundance, increase, and majority; here it is narrowed to proportional majority, not totality
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْثَرُهُم}} ({{tr:aktharuhum}}) makes the final charge precise. As an elative construct with a plural suffix, it measures a majority inside the accused group and serves as the subject of the closing nominal clause. The k-th-r abundance field becomes distributional dominance without totality. Same-surah majority language from 34:28, 34:35, and 34:36 is redirected here toward misplaced allegiance, and 12:103 is reversed by object: the problem is not belief as such, but belief in the wrong referent.

topics.headline: bounded majority as clause subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final diagnosis is proportionate and bounded to the accused group, not a universal statement about everyone.
topics.reason: The elative construct with a plural suffix serves as the subject of the final nominal clause.

topics.headline: majority, not totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the error is dominant without erasing a minority outside the assertion.
topics.reason: The k-th-r abundance field is locally narrowed into a sober majority measure rather than universal totality or boastful excess.

topics.headline: same-surah majority thread and belief reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices majority language shift from possessions or response patterns to misplaced allegiance, with 12:103 reversed by object.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give same-surah majority references 34:28, 34:35, and 34:36, plus the 12:103 belief contrast.

topics.headline: final distributional diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing clause moves from the worship object to how widely confidence had settled.
topics.reason: The quantified subject opens the final nominal clause and makes population distribution part of the diagnosis.

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns the final predicate into object-directed belief. Joined to {{ar:هِم}} ({{tr:him}}), it forms a compact complement to {{ar:مُّؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:muʾminūn}}); the fronted phrase makes the wrong object salient before the predicate arrives. It also echoes the earlier preposition-plus-pronoun relation in {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) {{ar:دُونِهِم}} ({{tr:dūnihim}}), changing exclusion into misplaced confidence.

topics.headline: preposition governs object of belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is object-directed and attached to a specific plural referent.
topics.reason: The clitic preposition governs the pronoun and attaches the prepositional phrase to the active participle of belief.

topics.headline: fronted object restricts belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wrong object is foregrounded before the believing predicate lands.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is fronted before the predicate, narrowing the meaning to believers in them rather than believers in an unmarked sense.

topics.headline: preposition-pronoun echo closes relation map
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final relation echoes the earlier exclusion phrase while changing from apart-from relation to belief-in relation.
topics.reason: The phrase repeats a preposition plus plural suffix shape against the earlier exclusion phrase and functions as the closure mechanism.

words.gloss_range: bound plural pronoun governed by the preceding preposition, with strong local pressure toward the jinn antecedent but some discourse openness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite collective accusative: the jinn as explicit object of worship

words.prose: {{ar:هِم}} ({{tr:him}}) keeps the object of confidence inside the prepositional complement. Nearest grammar pressures the pronoun toward {{ar:ٱلْجِنَّ}} ({{tr:al-jinna}}), carrying the named worship object into the closing belief diagnosis, though the attachment evidence warns against over-forcing the referent in translation. As a suffix, it also participates in the ayah's chain of plural relations: apart from them, most of them, in them.

topics.headline: pronoun carries jinn into closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the nearest grammar carries the jinn into the belief clause, while the wider pronoun chain keeps some relation-tracking pressure alive.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the pronoun referent as grammatically open in default translation, but the local nearest antecedent and object chain strongly pressure the jinn reading.

topics.headline: bound pronoun inside belief complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the false object is grammatically embedded in the belief complement before the predicate is stated.
topics.reason: The pronoun is bound to the preposition and fronted with it, not independent as a new subject or topic.

topics.headline: plural suffix chain maps false relations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a repeated plural suffix chain linking exclusion, majority, and belief object as relation-tracking devices.
topics.reason: The suffix recurs in the exclusion phrase, the majority quantifier, and the final belief complement.

words.gloss_range: active participle predicate: believers/trusters in them as a settled state of the majority
words.root_gloss_range: ʾ-m-n ranges over safety, trust, confirmation, belief, and entrusting; here the bi complement makes the state misplaced reliance in the wrong object

words.prose: {{ar:مُّؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:muʾminūn}}) is the ayah's final landing. As an active participle in a nominal clause, it freezes the majority as people characterized by belief or trust, not as people performing one more finite act. The ʾ-m-n root makes the diagnosis inward: their security and reliance had settled in the wrong object. That separates proper belief in the unseen from trust in concealed beings, with 2:3 as the contrast, and it turns the earlier worship of {{ar:ٱلْجِنَّ}} ({{tr:al-jinna}}) into a durable confidence-state.

topics.headline: settled nominal belief-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word predicates a settled identity or state for the majority, not another finite action.
topics.reason: The active participle is the predicate of the final nominal clause, agrees with the majority subject, and follows the fronted belief complement.

topics.headline: belief as misplaced security
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that misplaced belief is also misplaced reliance and security, not bare mental assent.
topics.reason: The ʾ-m-n range includes safety, trust, confirmation, and entrusting; with the bi complement, the state rests in the wrong object.

topics.headline: valid unseen belief contrasted with trust in hidden beings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah separates proper belief in the unseen from trust in concealed beings, with 2:3 as the sharp contrast.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply 2:3 and same-surah belief movement; locally the object carried by the fronted complement reverses the evaluative force.

topics.headline: closure turns worship into confidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends not merely with whom they served, but with the confidence that had settled there.
topics.reason: The final participle closes the ayah after the worship clause, tying outward service to durable inward reliance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم
baseline_models.mechanism: The uttered tasbih clears God of the proposed association, while the wali and min dunihim construction denies a reciprocal alliance with the referenced group and states the speakers' actual allegiance before bal corrects the worship-object.

activation_trace.role: Overtly produced speech makes the clause testimonial rather than an unvoiced attitude.
Exonerating transcendence supplies the speech's rejection of the proposed association.
Alliance, love, and support define the relation the speakers affirm with God and deny with the human group.
The other-than or substitute relation makes the patronage claim exclusive rather than additive.

changed_reading.before: A praise formula followed by the naming of the speakers' true ally.
changed_reading.after: A spoken exoneration that denies reciprocal patronage with the humans and relocates the speakers' alliance exclusively with God before identifying the effective recipient of worship.

baseline_models.mechanism: Bal replaces the proposed recipient with al-jinn; kana presents the submissive practice as an established state, and the concealment field of j-n-n makes the correction disclose an effective object lying beneath the claimed relation.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence through time casts the worship as an established prior condition, not a momentary error.
Submissive worship and obedience specify the practical allegiance being diagnosed.
The concealed jinn are the literal class installed as the corrected object of worship.
Concealment supplies the diagnostic mechanism: the effective recipient is disclosed from beneath a mistaken attribution.

changed_reading.before: They worshipped jinn rather than the speakers.
changed_reading.after: The correction exposes an established allegiance beneath the professed relation: submissive practice ran to concealed beings, while the named speakers deny having received it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ ۖ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The first clause predicates worship of the group, whereas the second restricts settled belief to most of them. Numerical majority and heart-settled credence make the second clause an audit of inward penetration rather than a redundant restatement.

activation_trace.role: Submissive practice supplies the broader collective behavior.
Numerical abundance marks a majority while leaving a remainder outside the qualification.
Heart-settled assent specifies the inward conviction attained by most participants.

changed_reading.before: Worship and belief repeat the same accusation in two forms.
changed_reading.after: Collective submissive practice is broader than settled conviction: most, but not necessarily every participant, internalized trust in the jinn.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same jinn are first presented as workers acting by permission and later exposed as not knowing the unseen. The focus therefore describes an inverted hierarchy: humans submit to concealed beings who are themselves subordinate laborers with bounded authorization and failed hidden knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The concealed jinn remain the literal focus object whose rank is being reassessed.
Submissive obedience supplies the downward human-to-jinn relation that the context inverts.
The same concealed class appears inside a labor arrangement rather than as an autonomous patron.
Purposive work assigns the jinn a worker role in the supplied hierarchy.
Permission and authorization bound that work under a superior will.
Knowledge as disclosure is placed in an unreal condition and thereby denied to the jinn.
The unseen is the concealed domain they fail to know, separating hidden existence from hidden knowledge.

structural_cues: 34:12 places al-jinn in a partitive construction before a work verb and a permission phrase.
34:14 makes al-jinn the subject of a disclosure and puts knowing the unseen inside an unreal condition.
34:41 reverses that subordinate class into the object of human worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies jinn working by permission and their disclosed failure to know the unseen; I infer that a permission-bound, ignorant worker cannot be the final patron the worshippers treat it as. A live alternative is that these verses establish jinn subordination without specifying what the humans expected from them.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely substitutes jinn for the apparently addressed recipients.
changed_reading.after: The substitution is hierarchical irony: people submitted to hidden beings who were themselves controlled, punishable workers and not masters of hidden knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah sets a few grateful servants against a majority, then shows a conjecture realized through followership while denying the followed figure any coercive authority. The focus's worship-belief pair becomes a diagnostic distribution of voluntary allegiance: most settle into the following, while a believing faction remains distinct.

activation_trace.role: Numerical abundance in the focus supplies the captured majority.
Settled assent identifies what has taken hold in that majority.
Explicit fewness supplies the numerical counterweight to the focus's most.
The few are located among God's submissive servants, furnishing an alternative allegiance.
Realization of a prior expectation links conjecture to its behavioral fulfillment.
Conjecture and imagining characterize the script that the followers make effective.
Following as allegiance supplies a concrete mechanism by which worship operates.
A separated faction preserves the minority exception within the wider following.
Settled belief marks the excepted faction on the opposite side of the sorting.
The explicit absence of power or authority prevents the following from being explained as coercion.
Interpenetrating doubt supplies the unstable alternative that the test distinguishes from belief.

structural_cues: 34:13 says few among My servants, while 34:41 says most of them.
34:20 expresses followership with an exception for a believing faction.
34:21 negates authority and states a purpose of distinguishing belief from doubt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies numerical contrast, following, an excepted believing faction, no coercive authority, and a belief-versus-doubt test; I infer that the focus records voluntary capture by allegiance rather than forced compliance. Ritual worship may still coexist with this followership mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Most participants added inward belief to a broader collective practice.
changed_reading.after: Most participants were sorted into settled jinn-allegiance by following a conjectural script without coercion, while a small believing-servant minority remained outside it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling those claimed apart from God is followed by a systematic removal of ownership, share, support, benefit, and independent intercession. The focus's wali claim therefore concerns real jurisdiction and access, not sentiment alone; bal exposes concealed jinn as the beneficiary of a failed substitute-access chain.

activation_trace.role: Alliance and support anchor the focus in an actual patronage relation.
Other-than or substitute status marks the competing relation denied by the speakers.
Calling by speech supplies the attempted access action directed to claimed others.
An assertion without certainty weakens the claimed status of those invoked.
The exact substitute relation recurs around the invoked figures and links directly to the focus.
Ownership and power of disposal are explicitly denied, removing jurisdiction from the substitutes.
Participation or share is denied, closing a joint-authority route.
Back-strengthening aid is denied, closing a support route.
Benefit is the expected positive capacity that the passage makes unavailable on its own.
A mediator joining another supplies the last possible access link.
Permission subordinates even mediation to authorization and removes independent access.

structural_cues: 34:22 repeats min duni, the focus's substitute-relation construction.
The sequence moves from invocation through ownership, share, aid, benefit, and intercession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an invocation followed by negated capacities and permission-bound mediation; I infer that worshippers sought protection or access through a substitute chain and that 34:41 identifies its concealed beneficiary. A live alternative is submission without any expected benefit or intercession.

changed_reading.before: The speakers say God, not the humans, is their ally.
changed_reading.after: The speakers deny an entire patronage-and-access transaction: the proposed recipients possess no reciprocal jurisdiction, while effective devotion has flowed to concealed jinn through the failed chain.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier exchange returns accusation between weak and arrogant parties; later all are driven together, the angels are directly asked whether they received worship, and the next verse rules out mutual benefit or harm. The focus is thus witness testimony in an adjudication of agency, recipient, and capacity.

activation_trace.role: Repeated overt speech stages reciprocal accusation as testimony rather than private blame.
Driving and collecting a group to a destination supplies the hearing's compulsory assembly.
Complete gathering makes the questioned population comprehensive rather than selective.
The spoken divine question elicits the focus response as direct testimony.
The angel branch identifies the questioned party whose alleged receipt of worship is at issue.
The repeated temporal-state verb frames the question about an established past practice.
The identical submissive-worship branch states the charge that 34:41 corrects.
The focus utterance functions as the witnesses' answer within that exchange.
Exoneration gives the testimony a formal disavowal before it reallocates the worship-object.
The verdict removes every party's power of disposal over another.
Benefit names one patronal capacity that no gathered party can deliver.
Harm names the opposite capacity that is equally unavailable.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 stage returned speech and responsibility-shifting between social groups.
34:40 asks إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ and 34:41 answers with بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ.
34:42 immediately converts the testimony into a capacity verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blame-dialogue, total gathering, a direct worship question, an answer, and a no-capacity verdict; I infer that the focus allocates effective recipient and responsibility as forensic evidence. The answer can remain doxological while also serving this adjudicative role.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a free-standing doctrinal denial by the speakers.
changed_reading.after: It is elicited witness testimony: the angels reject receipt, identify the concealed effective recipient, and thereby prepare the verdict that none of the parties owns benefit or harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night-and-day command installs rival counterparts, while inherited worship is defended and the incoming truth is dismissed through reversal and deception language. These social and rhetorical channels make it possible for devotion to be consciously framed as ancestral practice while its effective concealed object is diagnosed as jinn.

activation_trace.role: Concealment anchors the claim that the effective recipient need not match the devotees' overt framing.
The literal jinn remain the named hidden agents; the social mechanism does not replace them.
Command and obligation supply a human channel that directs people toward rival-making.
A rival counterpart names the publicly installed object through which allegiance is organized.
Submissive worship recurs as the practice attributed to the fathers.
Fatherhood and upbringing supply intergenerational transmission for that practice.
Falsehood turned away from truth characterizes the narrative used to preserve inherited worship.
Diversion and deception supply a second rhetorical defense against disclosure.

structural_cues: 34:33 places command under the continuous frame of night and day before making rivals.
34:43 repeats kana plus worship for the fathers immediately after the focus hearing.
34:43 surrounds inherited worship with three public sayings that reclassify the challenger and the truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies elite command, rival-making, inherited worship, and truth-reversing labels; I infer that these are channels through which concealed jinn receive effective obedience without requiring every devotee to name them consciously. Direct and conscious jinn worship remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The group knowingly addresses jinn as its explicit cult object.
changed_reading.after: Jinn-directed obedience may be socially mediated through commanded rivals, inherited practice, and truth-reversing narratives, so the conscious label and the effective recipient can diverge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's dun can carry nearness short of the goal, while the ending contrasts seizure from a near place with a declaration of belief that cannot reach from a far place and is finally blocked by a barrier. Belief in the jinn becomes misplaced proximity: trust settles on nearer substitutes but leaves genuine belief inaccessible when disclosure arrives.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that falls short of the goal supplies the focus's latent spatial relation.
Settled assent anchors the spatial model in the focus's actual act of believing in them.
Failure of attainment closes escape at the moment of exposure.
Seizure and capture make the near location operational rather than merely descriptive.
Nearness locates the effective grasp that reaches them.
The same settled-assent branch now voices late belief in it, contrasting with prior belief in them.
Reaching by extension supplies the access that is impossible from the stated distance.
Distance opposite nearness locates the failed attempt at belief.
An intervening barrier turns spiritual distance into blocked access.
Interpenetrating doubt names the unstable state maintained before the barrier.
Agitated suspicion intensifies that distance from settled true assent.

structural_cues: 34:51-53 repeat makan with near, far, and far in successive verses.
34:41 has بهم مؤمنون, while 34:52 answers with آمنا به after exposure.
34:54 concludes with a barrier between the people and what they seek.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dun's near-but-short branch, settled belief in them, and an ending organized by near seizure, far reaching, and a barrier; I infer a topology in which false trust chooses proximate substitutes but produces distance from recoverable true belief. Min dunihim may still function simply as apart from them, so the spatial reading is supplementary.

changed_reading.before: Min dunihim only excludes the humans from the speakers' alliance, and belief in the jinn is purely propositional.
changed_reading.after: The exclusion also activates a failed-distance map: nearer substitutes receive settled trust, yet that trust leaves the worshippers too far away to reach belief when it matters.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it moves from al-jinn as beings to the j-n-n shield branch and then to the surah's material armor sequence. It remains anchored in the focus's jinn and wali roots and in the post-focus benefit-harm test. Downstream prose should present it only as a protective-function analogy, never as a replacement gloss for al-jinn.

activation_trace.role: Alliance and support supply the protective function explicitly claimed for God.
The protective shield image recasts the expected function of the jinn as imagined cover.
Ample extension until a thing is covered supplies the armor's enveloping protection.
Pierced links joined together provide the material mechanism of a real fabricated shield.
Denied benefit tests and fails the supposed protective function of substitute patrons.
Denied control of harm completes the failure of the imagined shield.

changed_reading.before: The verse names hidden beings as the object of worship and God as the speakers' ally.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, devotees treated jinn as a metaphysical shield, but the speakers deny that protective function and reserve actual guardianship for God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from the noun naming jinn beings to the same root's mind-covering madness branch. It remains valid as a functional overlay because the surah repeats jinnah beside a command to reflect, while the focus keeps the literal jinn branch in view. Downstream prose must qualify it as an analogy for cognition captured by concealed prompting, not claim that al-jinn lexically means madness here.

activation_trace.role: The concealed jinn supply the indispensable literal anchor for the exploratory overlay.
Covering of reason opens a cognitive function associated with the same root.
An explicit madness occurrence activates the root's mind-covering domain elsewhere in the surah.
The heart's repeated consideration supplies the reflective process opposed to cognitive covering.
Negated madness immediately after the reflection command makes that opposition locally visible.

changed_reading.before: The worship is direct devotion to a class of concealed beings.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing that literal object, the worship can also figure devotion to concealed prompts that cover reflection and secure assent before scrutiny.

strongest_changes: The jinn labor and ignorance sequence turns their worship into an inverted hierarchy rather than merely a wrong label.
The few-most contrast, followership, and absence of coercive authority make majority belief a voluntary diagnostic capture.
The invocation, ownership, aid, and permission sequence turns wali into jurisdiction and access, while the hearing makes the focus formal witness testimony.
Commanded rivals and inherited worship allow the conscious social frame to diverge from the concealed effective recipient.
The near-far ending activates a supplementary topology of misplaced trust in nearer substitutes.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reuses exact focus roots and constructions on both sides of 34:41: jinn as workers, failed knowers, and a madness-root occurrence; most against few; min dun for claimed substitutes; kana plus worship in the question and ancestral practice; and belief in them against late belief in it. Those recurrences produced causal, juridical, social, and spatial mechanisms rather than a topical catalog.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise antecedent of him in min dunihim and the degree of conscious jinn-identification among the worshippers remain open within the focus syntax.
Direct cult, elite mediation, and inherited practice can coexist; the packet does not force one channel.
The distance, shield, and cognitive-covering activations are branch-led analogies and must not replace the focus's ordinary lexical reading.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Purification severs a falsely claimed alliance.** `س ب ح/B002` is declaring free, `و ل ي/B004` loyal alliance, `ج ن ن/B005` hidden spirit beings, and `ء م ن/B002` trusting assent. The response first clears God, then names its own alliance, then redirects the humans’ worship toward hidden beings. Purification removes false attribution; alliance identifies the true relation; concealment explains how assent attached elsewhere. The packet gives the correction; I infer that unseen mediation allowed one relation to be represented as another. The ayah reads `سبحانك` as forensic disassociation as well as praise.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:42 immediately showed the consequence of the corrected alliance: hidden objects of trust cannot own benefit or harm for their adherents.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Purification before relational correction.** `س ب ح B002` supplies declaring free or pure, `و ل ي B001` nearness and adjacency, and `و ل ي B004` loyal alliance and support. The response first disavows the association, then relocates true nearness and support to God rather than the worshippers. The branches assign `سُبْحَٰنَكَ` the clearing role and `وَلِيُّنَا` the corrected relational role. The packet supplies their order; I infer that false affiliation must be removed before the actual alliance is named. The answer reads as a topology of allegiance, not only a denial.

2. **Hidden agency occupying a misdirected relation.** `ج ن ن B001` supplies concealment and `ج ن ن B005` hidden spirit beings. The questioned angels reject the relation, and the ayah redirects it toward an unseen object; 34:43 invokes magic and fabricated speech, while 34:46 reuses J-N-N for alleged mental veiling. The branches assign concealment the role of making projection difficult to audit. The packet supplies mistaken address and repeated hidden-agency accusations; I infer that invisibility fills the gap between claimed and actual patron. Worship reads as misdirected relational trust sustained by concealment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:46's `جِنَّةٍ` turned the J-N-N root back onto the accusers' epistemology: the hidden is first made an object of worship, then mental covering is projected onto the warner. This exposed concealment as a repeated explanatory substitute.

baseline.text: Melekler, ‘Seni eksiklikten uzak tutarız. Onlar değil, sen bizim koruyucumuzsun. Hayır, onlar cinlere tapıyorlardı; çoğu onlara inanıyordu’ derler.

findings.text: Eksiklikten uzak tutma sözü, yanlış yakıştırmayı temizleyip ilişkiyi ayırır; ardından gerçek yakınlık Allah'a taşınır ve gizli varlıklara yönelmiş güven açığa çıkarılır.
Gizlilik, tapılan ile tapıldığı sanılan arasındaki boşluğu görünmez bir aracıyla doldurarak yanlış ilişkinin denetlenmesini zorlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sesle ortaya çıkarılan söz ve harflerden kurulu sözlü ifade olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve aynı çekirdeği taşıyor; dil organı, hükümdar unvanı ve mecazi yan kullanımlar bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çıplak söz söyleme ve söylenmiş söz çekirdeğidir; organ, unvan, söylenti ve mecazlar ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım çıplak söyleme ve sözlü ifade anlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşünceyi veya sözü sesli biçimde dışa vurma ve böyle dışa vurulmuş harfli sözlü ifade anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
Söylenen şey tek söz, cümle, şiir veya konuşma ölçeğinde olabilir.
Ad biçimleri aynı söylenmiş söz alanında toplanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sözü sesle dışa çıkarılan ve harflerden oluşan sözlü ifade çekirdeğinde toplar; ad biçimleri de aynı alana bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözü sesli biçimde ortaya koyma ve ortaya konmuş sözlü ifade için genel başlık olarak uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sesle dışa vurma ve sözlü ifade çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Fiil bağlamında kişinin sözü sesli olarak ortaya koymasını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Fiilsel söyleme işlemini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Söylenmiş ifade sonucunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ilgili biçimi doğrudan konuşma organı olan dil diye açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu organ anlamını doğru taşır ve söylenmiş söz ya da söz sahibi anlamlarını bu dalın dışında bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, Tanrı'yı her türlü kötülük ve eksiklikten uzak sayma çekirdeğini ortak biçimde verir; yüceltici kalıp, genel eylem ve Tanrısal niteleme bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'yı her türlü kötülükten, kusurdan ve kendisine yakışmayan nitelikten uzak sayarak yüceltmedir. Belirli söz kalıplarında bu uzak tutma, şaşma veya bir iddiadan ilişiksiz sayma işlevi de kazanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalın temelini arada yabancı bir unsur bulunmadan yakın olma, bitişik durma veya yanında bulunma olarak verir. Yer, ilişki ve bir evin başka bir eve bitişik olması gibi kullanımlar bu aynı yakınlık çekirdeğine bağlıdır.

Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak yalnızca mekansal yakınlık ya da yalnızca hedefe ulaşamama diye daraltılmamalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Hazırlanmış çerçeve kayıtları yazıya geçirme eylemini öne çıkarır, ancak kaynak ifadesi önce kayıt adının biçim açıklamasını ve çoğulunu, ardından kayıtların düzenlenmesi eylemini verir. Dal bu iki parçayı ayırarak korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kayıt defteri veya düzenli kayıt bütünü ile bunları yazıya geçirip düzenleme eylemi ayrılır; biçim açıklaması kavramın tanımı yerine geçmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kayıt adını taşıyan biçim ile kayıtları düzenlemeyi anlatan kalıp ayrı gösterilir; eylem anlamı adın bütün kullanımlarına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Düzenli kayıtların toplandığı defter veya kayıt bütünü ile bu kayıtları yazıya geçirip düzenleme eylemini kapsar. Adın biçimi, eski bir biçimdeki iki benzer ünsüzden birinin başka bir sesle karşılanmasıyla açıklanır ve çoğulu bu açıklamaya kanıt gösterilir.

facets.statement: Düzenli kayıtları bir arada tutan defter veya örgütlü kayıt bütünü adlandırılır.
Bu tür kayıtların yazıya geçirilmesi ve düzenlenmesi ayrı bir eylem olarak ifade edilir.
Adın biçimi eski bir ses düzenine bağlanır ve çoğul biçim bu açıklamanın dayanağı sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek aktarım, kayıt adının biçimini eski bir ses düzeni ve çoğul biçim üzerinden açıklar; ayrıca bu kayıtların yazıya geçirilip düzenlendiğini bildiren kullanımı verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin bir bölümü ilgili eyleme zayıflamak anlamı verirken, başka bir aktarım örneğin farklı bir sessiz yapıyla okunup başka bir köke bağlanabileceğini bildirir. Dal, güvenli ve genel bir kök anlamı olarak değil, aidiyeti tartışmalı bir aktarım olarak korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Zayıflama anlamı yalnızca tartışmalı aktarım olarak sunulmalı; doğrulanmış yalın anlam veya bütün kullanımlara yayılan bir çekirdek sayılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kabul edilmiş bir sözcük birimi bulunmadığından yalın kullanım varsayılmaz; anlam yalnızca kaynakta bildirilen belirsiz aktarım düzeyinde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir aktarım, ilgili eyleme zayıflamak anlamı verir; başka bir okuma ise aynı örneği farklı bir sessiz yapıya ve dolayısıyla başka bir köke bağlar.

facets.statement: Tartışmalı aktarımda bir varlığın gücünü yitirip zayıflaması anlatılır.
Alternatif okuma, örneğin sessiz yapısını değiştirir ve zayıflama anlamını başka bir köke bağlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımların bir bölümü zayıflama anlamını bu dala bağlar; başka bir okuma ise örneği farklı bir sessiz yapıyla açıklayıp kök aidiyetini tartışmalı hale getirir.

Pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oluşturma kullanımları aynı dal içinde bağımlı kullanımlar olarak durur; yer, konum ve üstlenme dalları bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.

Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nitelenen kişinin saygı gösterilen, yüceltilen ve hizmet edilen biri olduğunu açıkça belirtir. Bu anlam, benzer biçimin ezilmiş veya kullanıma hazırlanmış nesneyi nitelediği daldan karşıt bir değerle ayrılır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, saygı ve hizmet gören kişiyi niteler; alçaltma, köleleştirme veya nesneyi işleme anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın bir niteleme anlamıdır; özel bir söz öbeğine bağlı ek kapsam gerektirmez.

concept_map.definition: Kendisine saygı gösterilen, yüceltilen ve hizmet edilen kişidir.

facets.statement: Kişi çevresindekilerce saygıdeğer ve yüce tutulur.
Bu yüksek konumun sonucu olarak kişiye hizmet edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nitelemeyi saygı görme, yüceltilme ve hizmet edilme özelliklerini bir arada taşıyan kişi için kullanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin hem yüce tutulmasını hem de bu konum nedeniyle hizmet görmesini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Saygı görme, yüceltilme ve hizmet edilme özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin yüksek saygınlığı ile kendisine sunulan hizmet birlikte vurgulandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yüceltilme ve hizmet görme yönlerini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: saygı gösterilen, yüceltilen ve hizmet edilen kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin saygı görmesi yanında kendisine hizmet edilmesini de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişinin, anının veya makamın değerini yükseltme eylemine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: saygı gören kişi ve değerini yükseltme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişi veya makamın yüksek değer ve saygınlık kazanması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yüksek tutulup hizmet edilen kişiyi niteler; komşu dal ise bir kişi, anı veya makamı yükseltme eylemini daha geniş kapsamda anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin saygın konumunu ve gördüğü hizmeti bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal güzel nitelikleri sözle anıp yücelik yükleme eylemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal birini yüksek ve değerli gösterme alanına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir kişinin niteliği ve gördüğü muameledir; komşu dal ise övgü sözleriyle yüceltme eylemidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çekirdeği güç ve sağlamlık olarak verir; dayanıklılık ve kalıcılık bunun zaman içindeki görünümü, dişi devedeki semizlik ise canlıya özgü belirti olarak sunulur. Bunlar kölelik veya boyun eğmeyle ilişkili değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal fiziksel güç, sağlamlık ve dayanıklılığı anlatır; toplumsal kölelik ya da duygusal öfke anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın güç adı ile deve ve kumaşa bağlı söz öbekleri birlikte bulunur; canlıya özgü semizlik bütün dalın genel anlamı yapılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın güçlü, sağlam ve zaman içinde dayanıklı olmasıdır; dişi deve bağlamında bu sağlamlığa semizlik de eşlik eder.

facets.statement: Temel nitelik fiziksel güç ve sağlamlıktır.
Kumaş bağlamında güç, kullanıma karşı dayanma ve kalıcılık olarak görünür.
Dişi deve bağlamında güçlü yapıya semizlik de eklenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar güç ve sağlamlık çekirdeğinde birleşir; bunu kumaşın dayanması ve dişi devenin güçlü, semiz yapısı üzerinden somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalın niteliği, kumaştaki kalıcılığı ve devedeki güçlü yapıyı ortak çekirdekte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Güç, sağlamlık ve süreklilik boyunca dayanma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Niteliğin dişi deve için kullanıldığı ve güçle semizliğin birlikte anlatıldığı bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Canlıdaki güçlü yapı ve semizlik görünümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Kumaşın dayanıklılığını ve yalın sağlamlık adını göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kumaşın kullanım ve zaman karşısındaki gücünün sorgulandığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gücün kalıcılık ve dayanma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Dişi deveye özgü güç ve semizlik görünümünü dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kumaşın kalıcılığına ve dişi devenin semiz gücüne bağlı özel kullanımları içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal cesaret, yürek sağlamlığı, zorlu durum, çaba ve acı gibi daha geniş güç ve şiddet alanlarına uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal nesnenin veya hayvanın dayanıklı yapısıyla sınırlıdır; komşu dal ruhsal cesaretten zorlu koşullara kadar çok daha geniş bir güç alanı kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal güçle birlikte dayanıklılık ve kalıcılığı, deve bağlamında semizliği içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal tek bir şeyi sert, güçlü veya kimi aktarımda uzun diye niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal somut bir varlığın güçlü ve sağlam oluşunu anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal süre boyunca dayanmayı ve özel bağlamsal görünümleri kapsar; komşu dal doğrudan sert veya güçlü nesne niteliğidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; geniş güç alanı ve sert nesne niteliği, bu dalın dayanıklılık ile özel deve ve kumaş sınırını açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi incinmiş gurur, öfke ve kendini koruma duygusunu merkezde verir; ayrıca keder ve yoğun iç duygulanımı aktarır. Geçici çerçevedeki kaçırılmış şey için pişmanlık ayrıntısı kaynak cümlesinde açık değildir, bu yüzden tanım bu ek koşula bağlanmadan kurulmuştur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal incinmiş gururdan yükselen öfke ile kederli iç duygulanımı kapsar; güç ve sağlamlık anlamından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın duygu adı ile gururu incindiği için susmayı anlatan söz öbeği birlikte bulunur; susma yalnız özel kullanımın sonucudur.

concept_map.definition: İncinmiş gurur ve kendini koruma duygusuyla yükselen öfke ya da içe çöken kederli duygulanımdır; özel kullanımda kişi bu incinme yüzünden susar.

facets.statement: Duygu incinmiş gurur, onurunu koruma isteği ve öfke çevresinde oluşur.
Kaynak ifadesi anlamı keder ve yoğun iç sıkıntısına da uzatır.
Özel söz öbeğinde gururu incinen kişinin tepkisi susmak olur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar incinmiş gurur, öfke ve kendini koruma duygusunu ortak çekirdek yapar; bazı aktarımlar keder ve yoğun iç duygulanımı da aynı ad altında verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gurur ve öfke çekirdeğiyle kaynakta verilen kederli iç duygulanım uzantısını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İncinmiş gurur, öfke ve kederli duygulanımın birlikte oluşturduğu alanı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Onur kırılmasının öfke ve kendini koruma tepkisi doğurduğu bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İncinmiş gurur ve öfke çekirdeğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal öfkenin yanı sıra keder ve yoğun iç duygulanımı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal burunla ilişkilendirilen kendini koruma gururunu ve içte kabaran kızgınlığı özellikle vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal incinmiş onur, kendini koruma duygusu ve öfke alanında büyük ölçüde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kaynak aktarımında kedere ve iç sıkıntısına açılır; komşu dalın merkezi daha sıkı biçimde gurur ve kızgınlıktır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kederi incinmiş gurur ve öfke alanıyla birlikte taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kederin yanında sevgi, özlem ve başka duygusal yönelimleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yoğun iç duygulanım ve keder alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın duygusal çekirdeği onur ve öfkeyle sınırlanır; komşu dal sevgiye ve özleme de uzanan daha genel bir duygulanım alanıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı söz öbeğine bağlı anlam verir: bir işi yapmakta gecikmemek ve koşarken bir ölçü hızlanmak. Bunlar tek bir yalın eylem anlamına indirgenemez, fakat dal iki yapı açıkça ayrılarak korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız verilen iki söz öbeğinde gecikmeme veya biraz hızlanma bildirir; genel bir hız kökü gibi yorumlanmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bütün anlam söz öbeklerine bağlıdır; gecikmeme ve koşuda biraz hızlanma okumaları yalın biçime genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Verilen bir söz öbeğinde bir işi yapmakta hiç gecikmemeyi, diğerinde ise koşarken bir ölçü hızlanmayı anlatır.

facets.statement: İlk yapı, belirtilen işi yapmak için beklememeyi ve kısa sürede harekete geçmeyi bildirir.
İkinci yapı, koşunun hızını bir miktar artırmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi, gecikmeden yapma ile koşuda biraz hızlanma okumalarını iki ayrı yapıya bağlar; ortak bir yalın anlam ileri sürmez.

concept_gloss.text: gecikmeden yapmak veya koşuda biraz hızlanmak

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin belirtilen işi beklemeden gerçekleştirdiğini bildiren yapı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşi yapmak için oyalanmama ve gecikmeme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Koşuda biraz hızlanma okumasını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal koşuda veya geçişte belirli ölçüde hız kazanmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Hızlanma yönü bakımından yakındırlar, ancak odak dal iki özel yapıya bağlıdır ve ayrıca gecikmeme anlamı taşır; komşu dal doğrudan hızlı hareket alanındadır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insan kümeleri, nesneler, uzak uçlar ve farklı yollar için ortak olarak birbirinden ayrılıp çeşitli yönlere dağılma görüntüsünü verir. Bunlar köle adının çoğulları değil, dağınıklığı anlatan ayrı adlandırmalardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal insan, nesne veya yolların ayrı yönlere dağılmışlığını bildirir; kölelerin çoğul adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın bir çoğul adlandırmadır; özel bir söz öbeğinden alınmış ek kapsam içermez.

concept_map.definition: İnsan kümelerinin, nesnelerin, uzak uçların veya yolların birbirinden ayrılarak çeşitli yönlere dağılmış olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Birlik oluşturan öğeler birbirinden ayrılır ve değişik yönlere dağılır.
Dağılmış öğeler insan kümeleri, nesneler, uzak uçlar veya farklı yollar olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak biçimde her yana dağılma ve birbirinden uzaklaşma görüntüsünü verir; kapsam insan topluluklarından nesnelere ve yollara kadar uzanır.

error_profile.loses: İnsan kümeleri ve dağınık nesneler için kullanımı dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir kalıp içinde bir topluluğun her yöne gitme olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: her yana dağılmış öğeler ve dağılan topluluk

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal uzak uçlar ve farklı yönlere uzanan yollar gibi somut dağınık öğeleri özellikle kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal topluluğu dağıtma eylemine, türlerin ve gönüllerin farklılaşmasına kadar uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir bütünün parçalarının ayrılması ve dağılması alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yönlere yayılmış insan, nesne ve yolların durumudur; komşu dal ettirgen dağıtmadan soyut farklılaşmaya kadar daha geniştir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yolcunun bineği yorulduğu, zarar gördüğü veya ortadan kaybolduğu için yolda kalmasını anlatan yapı ile insanlara güçlük çıkararak direnen deve nitelemesini birlikte verir. Bu iki kullanım aynı dalda tutulabilir, ancak genel bir bozulma veya yorgunluk anlamı gibi birleştirilemez.
